readyPaidRecoveryBatch.priority: current_day_batch_in_order_then_return_to_recoverable_failures; never route to legacy 009 while current-day quota remains

categoryCompatibility.parent: ソフトウェア・ハードウェア

readyPaidRecoveryBatch.consumerInstruction: Process all five current-day items in one Windows-available recovery session. One strict success is never a stopping condition. After a brief recoverable failure, preserve that item as retryable, immediately move to the next current-day item, then return to held current-day items after the first pass. Count only buyer-visible pages passing every required check. Do not infer public URLs from admin/editor state.

windowsResumeContract.afterRecoverableFailure: mark candidate retryable, preserve payload/SHA, move to next current-day candidate without ending run
windowsResumeContract.afterFirstPass: return to any current-day held candidates until ledger contains all five required IDs
windowsResumeContract.completionPredicate: all five required IDs exist in canonical publication ledger with publicUrlVerified=true and all strict buyer checks confirmed

cloudPreflight.nextAction: On Windows availability, immediately consume the five current-day queue IDs, switch past briefly recoverable failures, then return to held current-day IDs until 5/5 strict ledger completion.

heldForLaterStrictReverification.reason: Already counted historically; never double-count current quota.

heldAlreadyPublishedNotNewDebt.reason: Historical publication cannot count as a new 2026-08-23 publication.

heldBlocked.reason: Legacy blocker deferred until the five genuine-new 2026-08-23 products are strict verified.
